module: In-memory cache of multi-seat (multiseat) assignments. It keeps a deep copy of the value passed to set and returns a copy to get, logging the reason for each access. Its unload mode is "manual", so the cache survives the automatic unloading of extensions.

onInit.desc: Extension initialization hook; sets the unload mode to "manual" via setExtensionUnloadMode and logs.

set.desc: Replaces the stored assignments with a deep copy of value and logs the reason.

reason.desc: Reason, used only for the log.

get.desc: Returns a deep copy of the stored assignments and logs the reason.

reason.desc: Reason, used only for the log.

returns.desc: Copy of the assignments, nil if nothing was set.
